meaning_fixes.before: No, it's that thief you mentioned.
meaning_fixes.reason: Source is '例のドロボウさんです' - 'rei no' marks 'that thief' as an already-established/well-known nickname, not a claim that Lt. Cmdr. Hoshino personally mentioned a thief to the speaker. 'you mentioned' invents a specific prior remark the source does not state (Hoshino's only preceding line is asking 'is that you?', not naming any thief).

meaning_fixes.before: The Martian Successors staged a shuttle explosion to kidnap Akito and Yurika...
meaning_fixes.after: The Martian Successors faked a shuttle explosion, covering up the real kidnapping of Akito and Yurika...
meaning_fixes.reason: Source '...爆破事故にみせかけた...誘拐事件' means the kidnapping was disguised AS a shuttle explosion accident (a cover story), not that the explosion was the method used to abduct them. This reading is confirmed two rows later at dialogue_05684, where Nergal similarly puts out a fake 'died in an accident' story to cover for Inez's survival - the same cover-up pattern. The old wording reversed cause and effect (explosion-as-method instead of explosion-as-cover-story).
